title: Photo Booth Hire Enfield | Boothdrop Entertainment
metaDescription: Photo booth hire in Enfield, Southgate, Palmers Green and Winchmore Hill for weddings, christenings and parties. Attendant and prints included. Call today.
h1: Photo Booth Hire Enfield, from Southgate to Enfield Lock
intro: Celebrations in Enfield tend to be generous, from Greek Cypriot and Turkish weddings in banqueting suites to milestone birthdays in a Winchmore Hill function room, and Boothdrop Entertainment brings a booth to suit each one. Every booking includes an attendant, props, unlimited sessions and free delivery and setup, with packages from £239.

sections.heading: Big weddings, christenings and family milestones
paragraphs: Weddings in the borough are often large and lively. Greek Cypriot and Turkish families host receptions with long guest lists, live music and dancing well into the night, and the same banqueting suites welcome Asian, African and Caribbean weddings and celebrations from many other backgrounds. A wedding photo booth Enfield guests will happily queue for needs to work quickly, print for everyone in the shot and look at home in a richly decorated room.

Family occasions do not stop at weddings. Christenings are frequently followed by a full meal and party, engagement celebrations can be almost as big as the wedding itself, and milestone birthdays, from a first to an 80th, fill function rooms all year. Schools across the borough hold proms in early summer, and offices hold Christmas parties through December, so both are worth booking well in advance.

sections.heading: Picking the right booth for an Enfield event
paragraphs: For the biggest receptions, the Inflatable Booth is the showpiece: an LED-lit cube that holds up to ten guests and glows in a colour matched to your theme. It needs about 4m by 4m of floor, a ceiling of 3m or more and two sockets, which most banqueting suites can provide. Magic mirror hire Enfield couples choose for a more classic look brings a full-length interactive mirror with animations, games, a DSLR camera and a guest book.

Where floor space is tighter, the Selfie Mirror Pod gives a similar mirror experience on a slim stand in around 2m by 2m. The Retro Pod makes a neat party photo booth Enfield hosts can fit into a smaller function room, with its inbuilt printer producing classic photo strips and keeping cables to a minimum.
list: Inflatable Booth: large receptions with high ceilings
Magic Mirror: weddings and engagement parties
Selfie Mirror Pod: christenings and compact rooms
Retro Pod: birthdays and vintage-themed parties

sections.heading: Enfield Town, Edmonton and the Hertfordshire border
paragraphs: Photo booth hire Enfield-wide means the whole London Borough of Enfield to us. We work in Enfield Town and Bush Hill Park, in Southgate, Winchmore Hill and Palmers Green towards the south-west, in Edmonton and Ponders End on the eastern side, and up to Enfield Lock in the north-east. The borough forms part of our North London coverage.

Just over the border, Cheshunt and Potters Bar in Hertfordshire are reached as easily as anywhere inside the borough, and venues further into Hertfordshire or across into East London are part of our regular routes too. Wherever the party is, the same attendant-led service applies.

sections.heading: Banqueting suites, golf clubs and function rooms
paragraphs: Enfield is well served by banqueting suites built for large family celebrations, typically with ground-floor access, wide doors, stages and generous dance floors. They suit the bigger booths, and we are used to working around caterers, bands and decorators setting up at the same time. Hotels offer a similar mix of space and loading access for weddings and corporate dinners.

Golf clubs give a quieter, greener setting for receptions, birthday dinners and charity evenings. Community halls, school halls and function rooms above or behind other premises host christenings, children's parties and proms; they vary a great deal in size and access, so a quick description or a few photos of the room help us recommend the right booth.

sections.heading: Arriving via the A10 and North Circular
paragraphs: Most of our journeys into the borough use the A10 or the A406 North Circular, with the A110 running east to west across it and junctions 24 and 25 of the M25 serving the northern edge and Hertfordshire venues. These roads are slow at peak times, so we time our arrival with plenty of margin and are set up before your first guests walk in. ULEZ applies across the borough and is covered by us.

Setup takes 45 to 60 minutes before the hire window and is never charged as hire time. Power is simple: a single ordinary socket near the booth, or a pair for the Inflatable Booth. Banqueting suites and hotels usually have parking or a loading bay; for halls on residential streets we unload at the door. Staircases suit the slimmer pods, while the Magic Mirror, Party Booth and Inflatable Booth need a lift or a ground-floor room.

sections.heading: Booking tips for Enfield hosts
paragraphs: Big receptions usually have a running order of entrances, speeches, first dance and live music, so share it with us and we will plan when the booth opens and pauses. Ask the venue whether other suppliers will be setting up at the same time, and let us know if there is a late finish so the hire window can match it.

Summer weekends, prom season and December fill up first. An £80 deposit holds the date, with the balance due one month before the event, and your custom print template can carry names, a date, a logo or a short message, proofed for your approval before the day.

faqs.q: Where will you park at a banqueting suite or a community hall in Enfield?
faqs.a: Banqueting suites and hotels usually have a car park or loading bay, and we unload there. For halls on residential streets we stop at the door, move the kit in on trolleys and then park the van nearby, so there is no disruption to your guests.

faqs.q: What if the room is upstairs with no lift?
faqs.a: The LCD SlimPod, GIF Booth, Retro Pod and Selfie Mirror Pod can all be carried up a staircase. The Magic Mirror, Party Booth and Inflatable Booth need a lift or a ground-floor room, so tell us about the access when you enquire and we will suggest the best fit.

faqs.q: Do you charge travel for Cheshunt, Potters Bar or Enfield Lock?
faqs.a: Delivery and setup are included throughout the borough and just over the Hertfordshire border. If any travel contribution ever applies to a far-flung venue it is shown on the quote up front, so there are no surprises once you have booked.

faqs.q: Is there room for the Inflatable Booth at our banqueting suite?
faqs.a: Usually, yes. The Inflatable Booth needs about 4m by 4m of floor, a ceiling of at least 3m and two standard sockets. Most banqueting suites have that space, but send us the room dimensions or a floor plan and we will confirm before you book.

faqs.q: Can you cover a christening and its party on the same day?
faqs.a: Yes. If the celebration moves from one venue to another, let us know the timings and both addresses. We will plan the booth for the part of the day where guests have most time to enjoy it and build that into a single quote.

faqs.q: Do guests get a guest book to sign?
faqs.a: Every print booth comes with a guest book, so guests can stick in a copy of their print and leave a message. It becomes a keepsake of the day that sits alongside the digital copies we email out.
